title: Two K-Pop Stars Make Their First Album as a Duo
summary:
Jeonghan and Joshua are singers in Seventeen, a very popular K-pop group with 13 members. Now the two have made their own album as a duo called JxJ. It is called "Dreamscape."

It is Jeonghan's first new music since he finished South Korea's required military service this summer. While he was away, he sometimes watched his bandmates perform from the crowd. "I missed those moments on stage," he said.

Joshua spent that time making songs. Jeonghan said he was amazed by Joshua's clear ideas for the album.

At first, the two did not agree. Jeonghan wanted a strong sound. Joshua wanted something softer. "Eventually, we met at the middle," Joshua said. Their main song, "12 O'Clock," is a dance song with a disco feel.

Joshua grew up in Los Angeles. He said singing as a pair lets him sing much more than in the big group. A tour is planned.
why_it_matters: It shows how two friends with different ideas can meet in the middle and make something new.
